text: This candidate received an overall fit score of 0.20 for the Senior Full Stack Software Developer position. The strongest evidence of their qualifications includes "Built REST APIs", along with listed experience in SQL, Git, and JavaScript. Key gaps include a lack of required experience in nodejs, ruby, reactjs, docker, ci/cd, and cloud computing, as well as having only 3.5 years of experience. Despite the low fit and missing must-have requirements, this application has been escalated for further review.
